title: Woodcore project template
description: template.json -- the file that makes a folder a template a new project is made from (calc/templates.py, docs/conventions/build-and-release.md §12, v0.94). The folder beside it is the project's skeleton, copied into every project made from it without this file. Written by Woodcore's *Paramètres* or by hand, read by calc/templates.py alone. Every key but the first three is optional: a template that states no language takes the settings' default report language, one that states no layout key the default layout, one that states no person the settings' defaults.

schema_version.description: -- pinned: a template written at another version is refused rather than read as this one.

format.description: What this file is, so a template.json that is something else is refused by name.

name.description: The template's name, as *Nouveau projet* and *Paramètres* list it. Its folder, and not this, is what the settings name it by (`<place>:<folder>`), so it may be edited.

description.description: What the template is for, in the engineer's words -- or, for a builtin template, one text per language (`fr`, `de`, `en`).

document_language.description: The language Typst itself works in, written into config.typ's `#let doc-lang` (docs/typst/language.md §4bis). Absent, the report language.

report_language.description: The language the engine prints in, written into the entry file's `#set-report-language(sys.inputs.at("lang", default: …))` (docs/typst/language.md §4bis). Absent, the settings' default report language, else German.

layout.description: Where the parts of the template's skeleton lie, relative to its folder -- the `layout` of schemas/woodcore-project.schema.json. A **report-shaped** template -- Standard, and one saved from a project laid out as a report alone -- states no `typst_root`: each key it leaves out takes the default, the skeleton's entry file lies where `report` says, and `generated` and `pdf` follow the report's folder where they are left out. A **documents-shaped** template -- saved from a project laid out in three documents -- states `typst_root` and with it every key, as that project's .woodcore did. A project made from either is laid out in three documents (calc/project_template.py), its folders named when it is made.

typst_root.description: "." -- stated by a documents-shaped template alone, with every key below.

config.description: "000-Typst-Config" -- stated by a documents-shaped template saved from a project laid out by folders (issue #64): the folder of its config.typ, commands.typ, title.typ, references.bib and Template/.

report_cu.description: The convention d'utilisation's entry file, in a folder of its own (a documents-shaped template).

report_bp.description: The base de projet's entry file, in a folder of its own (a documents-shaped template).

images.description: The pictures the three documents share, at the top (a documents-shaped template).

rfem_export.description: Retired in 0.117 with the RFEM import: still valid in a template written before, and not carried into a project made from it.

company.description: The office a new project's report is written by, unless the engineer types another.

author.description: Who writes a new project's report, unless the engineer types another.

checker.description: Who checks it, unless the engineer types another.
